name: Madera Equity
headline: End-to-end product delivery for a multifamily investment and management firm
overview: Madera Equity is a vertically integrated multifamily investment and property management firm focused on Sun Belt markets. Techlio delivered a digital product for Madera Equity from discovery and design through development, deployment and ongoing support.

solutions.title: Discovery
solutions.text: We worked with the client's team to define users, scope and success measures before any design or code.

solutions.title: Design
solutions.text: User flows and interface design for the product, reviewed with the client before build.

solutions.title: Development
solutions.text: Engineering and QA by a dedicated Techlio team, released in increments the client could use and test.

solutions.title: Deployment and support
solutions.text: Production launch, followed by an ongoing support agreement for fixes, improvements and new features.
